I sat down with Ben and Stephanie from The Social Greenhouse and we talked about how they built a super simple Plant Bingo business that made around $30,000 in profit in its first two months. They broke down how the idea started from seeing a viral TikTok, how they tested the first event with just 25 people, and how they now partner with breweries and restaurants that help promote the events for free. We also talked about why this works so well as an offline business, how they sell tickets in advance, what their plant costs look like, and how one big event brought in about $5,300 with roughly $3,000 in profit. Finally, we talked about how this could expand into other cities, private events, and even other bingo concepts like Book Bingo.
